text: This is a review of the king cake. We bought two king cakes and my family was excited to try it. When we opened one that day, it was hard and even heating it up in the microwave or in the oven on the lowest setting did not improve it by much. It tasted old, too. Buyer beware! Those hoping to gift a taste of New Orleans tradition for their family will be sorely disappointed and embarrassed!

The ice cream and cookie dough was really good but the description is misleading. They do not have Frozen yogurt and it is a little more pricey they said. That being said I would maybe come back again.

Ive been to a lot of CFAs in my time even participating in a few First 100s from Atlanta to Nashville. This is this slowest CFA I've ever been to. I placed an online order at 9 am submitted it and its currently 9:40 and im still waiting.  Staff doesn't seem up to par with other CFAs I've been to. Completely disappointed in this location. I was given my drink fairly quickly, however I still haven't received my food and its already melted.

Update: finally at 9:45 I went up to the window to ask that my money be refunded. I explained I was already late for work by this point and needed to leave. Nobody wanted to take care of doing that. Instead they yelled to go ahead and make my order. After still waiting a couple more minutes they handed me my order that I was unable to eat due to having to rush back to work. Worst experience ever for a CFA. Additionally most restaurants absolutely including CFA would apologize for the wait however not once was I told Sorry for your wait or here let me refill your melted ice coffee.

POOR SERVICE!
I ordered pickup via Grubhubb from Bleu Sushi for the 1st time on 11/25. I frequently use the app for various food orders and decided to give Bleu Sushi a try. I don't live far away so I rode my bike down to the restaurant for pickup. When I gave the waiter my name he refused to hand over the food until I had given him my phone number. I have a pretty unique name and he quickly pulled the bag from the waiting area, looked at me and hesitated giving me my food (which also included tip.) I suspect that the waiter did not believe I was the person who actually ordered the food. I am also a person of color. POCs: beware before ordering/eating from Bleu Sushi.
Service is great! My first time going, I asked if they can create a chicken sandwich made to my liking and it sure was fulfilling! Awesome response time to orders and customer requests.
Overalll okay. Typical bar food. Slow service.Buffalo cauliflower is the best thing on the menu.

This Red Lobster is GHETTO!!! Save your time and your money. You will get poor service, a poor attitude, and someone telling you that is above my pay grade! This place had good employees back in 1998. Now it's employees that ask when their break is and complain about people at the front desk!

This small but totally cute place is worth checking out. The food was on point and the price wasn't bad at all. I loved the attention details here. From the lanterns on the ceiling to the toppings on the crab California roll. Again the food was on point. Atmosphere was hip, young and definitely fun. The reason why I'm not giving a 5 stars is the drink size. The beer size is as big as a cup of coffee and we had to keep ordering more due to the small glass that it's served in. Maybe this was intentional to increase the bill but I rather you them charge more and give me a bigger glass. #babybeer

I'm working on checking out restaurants that are doing takeout during the current lockdown.  We tried Bab Cafe recently. Let me first say that the service was great. They took an order over the phone, had it ready when I requested, and waited patiently when my friend was late picking it up at closing.  Prices were fair also. My 3 stars is for the food, which admittedly suffered from take out. I'm a big fan of bibimbap, coming from the bay area where traditional Korean is easy to find. This dish is all about texture and spices and I found both a little lacking. We ordered the traditional bulgogi and the teryaki chicken. Perfectly adequate, but  not what I hoped for - which was a lot more spice and texture. I'll go again when I can eat in.

The food tasted good going down, but it did not sit well at all. Stomach cramps within an hour of eating! Be careful ordering DoorDash from here during quarantine times. I think some of their food is not holding up well.

Would've loved to have eaten here so I could rate the food. This low rating is the poor service we received on Saturday night, July 18. There were 4 of us. The hostess told us that the wait would be 30 minutes when we arrived at approx 9pm. Our husbands waited that 30 minutes while we went and played some slot machines. A half an hour later, our husbands called to tell us that this restaurant said they would no longer serve us because they were closed!! They told us they could give us 4 rolls for our wait but that was it!!! We waited 30 minutes to eat after we had driven there from sac and were  all starving just for them just for them to turn us away. This is so rude! I would've been ok with it if they just told us that they weren't taking anymore customers when we first arrived. We visit Reno quite often but will definitely NOT be going back to eat here!

Came here for al ate dinner one day and was impressed by their menu. A LOT  of choices, so if you enjoy Italian and want to try something special please do come here. The staff was lovely, and the atmosphere is beautiful.

The reason for 4 Stars and not 5: I always have trouble with my reservations when I come here. The hostess (Paige) was very rude and not accommodating though I made my reservation a couple weeks in advance. 

The food is always incredible. I LOVE the hot chicken sliders and sour cream potatoes. They also have $3 mimosas during brunch on the weekend!! The views are beautiful, the music is usually on point, and the vibes are immaculate. 

The person who deserves a 5 star review is Gracie!! She is INCREDIBLE. So attentive, quick, and personable. I felt like I was her only table because she was so tuned in to our table. Ask for Gracie!

Garbage food that we waited an HOUR for. They also forgot about us so when we stuck our face in the window I watched them put the wings in. 35 minutes in they started our food. Also when I got my fries I ordered them with cheese and they came plain...which wouldn't be a big deal except it's the only thing I ordered. 20 minutes after I got my fries they gave my friend his wings....this was all the same order. I wish I was exaggerating the times but I'm not....groups of people came and went and I e still didn't have our food. I understand they are a food truck and a small business but they weren't busy they were completely regular. I'm completely unhappy with this food truck all around

Update: friend just opened his food when we got home and he had ordered 10 wings and he only got 4. He got 4 shitty wings.....

Just because you roll in on a college campus doesn't mean you can rip people off.
Will never eat here again.

First time trying Noodle cafe and it was a HIT!!! Tried the Szechuan chicken. Which tasted wonderful and not too spicy or tangy. White rice cooked to perfection. Chicken chow mein was fantastic with thick noodles. Crab Rangoon fell a little flat on taste but LOTS of crab which made up for it in my opinion. Shrimp Pho was spot on. Hot broth. Fresh crispy sprouts. Beautiful basil sprigs and cilantro leaves. Lime and thin egg noodles. Shrimp were cooked to perfection. The side addition of Sriracha packets added just the right amount spice. All around delicious. The restaurant itself was very clean which is always a plus. We will definitely be returning ! YUUMMM

Good food but horrible service at the front. 8 girls standing at the front desk looking at their phones didn't acknowledge us for at least a minute of standing at the desk. Finally a server walking by realized what was going on and greeted us. Then a girl at the desk,while still looking at her phone, asked how many were in our party. Not one of them looked up at us the entire time. Extremely rude and unprofessional.

Well I decided to try Thai 5 because a friend said they were awesome. I must say, they did not disappoint. We ordered the short rib box, crab fried rice, potstickers, mango sticky rice, crab rangoon, and buffalo and bbq wings. I  gave them 5 stars because the service was friendly and quick, the food was delicious and prices were reasonable. We definitely will be returning.

My girlfriend and I had been waiting to get back to St. Louis for a few years since our first trip there and we found this restaurant the second night of our stay and we absolutely loved it! She had found a few different wines that she had never tried before and I tried some new local beers that were all highly recommended by the waitstaff. The food was incredible, I urge anyone to try the soft pretzels with the IPA beer cheese and I guarantee it'll be one of the best appetizers you've ever had. We also got the bison charcuterie board which was incredible as well. There were three different servers helping us and all of them were extremely friendly as well as knowledgeable about their beers and wines. In addition to all that, the Covid procedures were carried out professionally with everyone wearing masks and being seated at evenly spaced tables. The next time we go back to St. Louis we will no doubt be coming back here!

Coffee Times has the best coffee and chai in Tucson. They're so friendly, and we love that they also sell food from other local vendors. I laugh a little at the negative reviews from people who don't want to wear a mask in their car and say they're going to Dutch Bros. instead, when several Dutch Bros. locations have had to shut down for COVID-19 cases.

You can never go wrong at Wright's Gourmet. This is a South Tampa favorite whether you are dining in or dashing in to take out. Love their soups and sandwiches. Desserts are phenomenal and always a difficult decision on which to pick.

Liked Pies and Pints very much.  Sorry to see the last two places come and go, the competition in Carmel is fierce.  So here's a few things that might help Pies do well:

Great price on PBR pints and pitchers.
Great salads that you can share.
Great pizza with a twist on your favorite recipes.

We had their take on pineapple pizza - the menu says pineapple and bacon (instead of ham) but the bacon wasn't what we expected. It was soft and flavorful with large pieces.  Excellent choice.

Margarita pizza - this was good, I will order with extra sauce the next time but was good both fresh and heated up the next day.  No tip droop on these pizzas, the crust is excellent...

Great service, lots of room for large groups, indoor, outdoor, and sort of in between seating.

Went here last night - it was busy. They had the tables separated outside and were trying to make some Covid accommodations but it def wasn't a place I'd return to at this time or probably ever considering the food was below average (fried Cajun chicken salad and wings) and the drinks not good at all. However the server was so nice and as accommodating as he could be so he really deserves another 2stars.

gone downhill, and i know - been going here for years. ordered sliced bbq pork and she brought out the ribs. when i pointed this out, she took the ribs back and gave me some dry pieces of sliced pork. i had paid for the order prior to receiving my order and when she exchanged the items she said "same amount." the sliced pork cost less than the ribs.
recently ordered the vegetable dumplings - used to be tender and delicate flavor. the only way to describe them this time is "weird" - an off taste, thick dough, and pieces of stuff inside that didn't mesh.
i'll try one more time then that's it.

We walked in and were greeted immediately which was great. Sat down ordered drinks and apps. They all came out fast and from there the service went down hill. Roughly 40 minutes for our 3 of the 4 meals to come out. Never saw our waitress but once when we asked for refills and she never brought them out. Had to ask the hostess to get us more drinks which she had no problem doing. After getting our food we then waited another 7 minutes until my 6 year old sons kids pasta came out which appeared to maybe been reheated 8 times because the pasta appeared to be small cement sticks covered in butter they were so hard.   For A family of 4 with 2 alcohol drinks and 1 app and 4 meals the bill came out to 116$.  We would have been 15 times more happy and gotten more bang for your buck at chick fil A. Very disappointed. To only see your waitress approx 3 times in A span of an hour and some change it's not reassuring. It's A shame because this place looks busy and very nice from the street. Maybe we were just unlucky....  unfortunately it cost me 116$ to find out

Pizza?   This is no pizza joint.  Incredible bar, restaurant, amazing staff.   The owners greet you when you come in.   We got the specials.  Amazing scallops wrapped in bacon.

Warrington finally has a respectable classy dinning experience.    Well done!!!!
10/10 recommend, service was amazing and so safe for COVID. They even personalized my menu for a dairy allergy! The food was fabulous and drinks were delicious.

My office ordered 6 pizzas, they didn't give us 2 of them. After multiple phone calls they made us pick up the pizza they missed and still missed our large meat lovers which they had the nerve to claim they delivered already when 30 employees in this office can verify that they did not.  Customer service was awful and we plan to never use them again.
If we hadn't gotten crackers for our clam chowder there would not be any substance to the chowder. Poor!
GreaT seafood and Excellent service. Will definitely recommend them and my visits will be repeated again and again and etc.... You'll Rock!!!
I ordered bahn mi and a beef noodle dish. The sandwich was decently the beef noodle was lacking fish sauce, tang, spice and just plain

This location used to be good. I almost always just order take out. When you dine in for the most part when you dine in they get orders correct. Staff is friendly. Resturant is clean. However for take out, check your order before you leave. I have got the wrong order the last 3 times. I ordered buffulo chips and got chips and salsa. The salsa trust me is not good, so I wouldn't order it anyway!  
Bad take out service plus order is almost never ready on time.

I love Redstone.   Always can count on a solid meal with good service.   They have had a happy hour which I have yet to visit until tonight.   There is a limited food menu with varying prices and also limited drink options.   I have to say their Parmesan truffle fries where amazing!!!   Thin and crispy with lots of different amazing flavors.  A must have.    Good drinks.  Great service at the bar ask for John.   Also I love their steak Cobb salad and buffalo shrimp which are my usual go to items.

We've been here a few times. This first visit was the best experience and was during lunch. They're pretty quick with getting your sandwich made, so even long lines don't necessarily mean long wait. I'd say it's a decent joint for a cheesesteak but not my favorite. I can tell the meat is cooked longer than my preference. One major improvement they could make is with the whiz. It's super watery and soaks right up into the paper wrapping. Unfortunately, our last experience was mediocre. The meat was a bit dry and the onions were so cooked they dissolved into a mush that was not a good texture.

Extremely rude. Horrible service.
On hold for 15 minutes.

"We're full thank you bye."

First time in this restaurant.  Great service. Food was great.  Mark, the manager was great.  He accommodated our large group and assisted us with all our requests.  I would highly recommend this restaurant.  The prices are in line with other restaurants downtown.  They even offer a parking discount if you give them the coupon off of the parking tag.

If I could give 10 stars then I would! My boyfriend and I did a double date here for an early Valentine's Day / Birthday event for us all. The entire experience from start to finish was absolutely mind blowing. TJ was our server and he was so patient with us. We had a million questions for him and he never once hesitated while answering each of our questions with such confidence. This was by far the best service I have ever experienced in any restaurant, ever. Hands down. The food was beautifully prepared and the taste of everything was phenomenal. Everything was executed perfectly throughout the night. The atmosphere of the entire restaurant was so relaxing and elegant. We have never experienced something so amazing. I would highly recommend the Sinema to anyone looking for a special night out.

The Bibimbap Bowl is such an amazing mixture of various ingredients and flavors over a bed of rice.  You can even add an egg if you wish.  This place is locates inside the Silverball room which has a great assortment of pinball machines.

I can't say enough good things about El Fuego. We went to their first location when they opened not too long ago, new location is so much better. Awesome outdoor sitting area. The food is BOMB. The street tacos are my go to, with an extra side of their delicious pico de gallo. The margaritas are the BEST. Im extremely picky about my margs, too. And $3.99 (not weak either...) cannot beat it. This will be our regular spot. Owner is an absolute gem, as well.

Saw this spot on Instagram and decided to give it a try.  I ordered a roast pork with sharp provolone and long hots.  The roll was perfect, seeded jawn.  Long hots weren't overly hot and complimented this sambo nicely.  I liked that the pork wasn't sliced to thin.  My only critique was it could've used a little more au-jus but that won't keep me from coming back!  Maybe ask for it on the side next time.

Food and service are excellent! I came here during the restaurant week. It come with three courses including appetizer, salad and main course. Everything we ordered is wonderful, very tasteful and creative. I remember we had herb flat bread, beets salad, arugula and Brussels sprout salad, pan roasted chicken and short rib. I also like the interior decor and atmosphere. The server was very attentive as well. I would definitely come back in the future to try more food.
Great chicken fried steak breakfast!  Fork tender.  The sausage gravy had great favor and the hash browns weren't too greasy

The perfect soft serve ice cream. We went on a hot summer day for a cone and really enjoyed it! It's an unassuming little place but delicious nonetheless. Great for children and adults and had COVID precautions in place

Best pizza and cheesesteak in town. We hope it stays under-the-radar but it's too good not to share about. Limited outdoor seating so we do take-out. TIP: cash only and you can't order ahead, so make sure you have 20-30 minutes to kill when you arrive because you'll have to wait while they make the pizza!

The food was ok,  nothing to rave about. I went in on a Saturday evening with a group of several ladies. We arrived around 8:00pm and ordered at 8:20pm. I ordered a Caesar salad and the cauliflower steak. The salad came about 30 minutes later and the cauliflower steak came out an hour later. The service was lacking.

Second time going to this location. Never any spoons or crackers for the chili. I asked how am suppose to eat the chili and they handed me a fork! Really? I hope the manager that does the ordering goes out and has a steak dinner and they give him or her a spoon to eat it! Get with it and do the correct ordering. Two times is unacceptable!

Be very careful when ordering takeout. We ordered the other night & when we picked it up the bill was $10 more than menu prices. They should tell you that when ordering. Even though we like their food this was very dishonest. When we called to complain they said we were on the wrong website.  We double checked & we were on the proper website.

The best Greek food that we have ever had-- hands down! Everything here is made from scratch and worth the 10-20 minute wait. We had an experience eating here. My boyfriend said his Gyro was the best in central Indiana because it's perfectly seasoned and cut. I ordered the Spanikopita appetizer (flaky, spinach and cheese pastry) and it blew my mind. For my entree, I can't remember the name but it was basically seasoned meatballs, rice, and pita. It was amazing, also. The two chefs/waitresses were extremely passionate about their food and were very welcoming! They even brought us out a free sample of a few Greek desserts as I had never had them before. Side note: they were delicious!! We will definitely return soon.

I appreciate the history behind the name Antoine's, and was excited to participate in their summer lunch special.  After being seated in the very front room, which was rather bland and quiet, my waiter was helpful and prompt.  However, I did order a cocktail that was never brought out, which was a bummer.
For my meal, I ordered the oysters, the chopped steak salad, and the key lime tart.  Here are my opinions...
Oysters: Delicious!  Thoroughly enjoyed them; they were (unfortunately) the highlight of my meal
Chopped Steak Salad: There is something strange about cold fried onion strings.  I was anticipating that they would be warm, so the first taste was a bit off.  Not a huge deal, but not that great.  The biggest issue for me was the salad dressing.  I'm not sure what they added into it (cilantro? dill?) but it had such a different non-ranch-like taste/aftertaste that I couldn't really eat any of the salad.  I pulled out the steak, which was good, and some of the bacon and cheese that had minimal dressing, but left over two thirds of my meal on my plate because I couldn't get past that taste.
Key Lime Tart: The tart casing was really robust - so robust that you had to almost squish the tart to get it to break.  The cream was overly sweet and heavy, and the lime curd wasn't able to balance it out.

Overall it was a disappointing experience.  I really wanted to enjoy my meal, but too many things didn't go right.  I don't know that I would go back of my own volition, but I'm gla

Found this restaurant on Yelp. I love the atmosphere, oldie but modern feel. The entire staff was really nice. Informed the bus boy this was our first time and he helped pick out couple things from the menu. We had the spinach dip, strawberry salad which was delicious and the Mac and cheese with pulled pork. I was hoping to try the chicken fried chicken but that dish was discontinued. Other than that pretty good.

Ordered their sushi on ubereats and am a happy customer. I am on a very low carb diet so I had a few special requests and they were very flexible in doing so. The quality of ingredients they use is excellent. I ordered the sashimi roll, blossom roll, salmon skin hand roll without rice and eel sashimi. I love that I found a good sushi place that I can have rolls without rice oMost sushi places I'm left to order sashimi. This is going to be my new go to spot!

Love this place! We went in wanting to try a bunch of different things and left impressed. Everything was delicious (we did two entrees, 3 apps and each had a signature drink). Reasonably priced and the decor is perfect. Definitely recommend trying this place

If you love hummus and you're craving for a hummus meal, then this is your place. It was my 1st time trying a restaurant like this and overall, it was a pretty good experience. The hummus looked fancy. This restaurant only sells hummus meals and with some veggie sides to choose from that comes along with the meal. Most def a go-to if you're vegetarian. I'm not, but every time I had a hummus craving I'd pick up something from here.

Taco salad last night was missing half the ingrediants. No onions olives tomatoes or avacado. No lime dressing.   Litterally all that was in it was salad meat a little cheese and tortilla chips. No way worth the 18.50 i paid.

My friend and I tried this sushi restaurant based on recommendation and it did not disappoint. The owner was extremely friendly and welcoming. Everyone we spoke to gave us incredible recommendations to the menu. The U-Arts Roll was extremely tasty and different than anything I've ever had! We were gifted sake, ice cream, and an ice tea to go. Great environment! Can't wait to go back and try more delicious rolls!

I recently went to New Orleans with a group of family and friends to celebrate my husband and his best friend's 30th birthdays. I decided to make a reservation her for our last night as a final birthday celebration and I'm certainly glad we did. This restaurant has old-school southern charm, great service, delicious cocktails and most importantly amazing food.

We had a later reservation, 8:15 on a Saturday, and half of the party arrived pretty early but was seated promptly. When the second half (my half) got there we were sat and attended to immediately. I enjoyed the signature old fashioned, which was very classic but did have a special twist. The waitstaff is great, you have a drinks water and a food waiter to make sure you're constantly taken care of.

For dinner I had the steak and my husband had the fish. The steak was cooked perfectly, on the rare side, which is absolutely fine with me. You can't un-cook meat! Two people decided that they needed a steak to split after they finished their meal. The waitress was more than happy to accommodate and they had a perfectly cooked steak very quickly.

The deserts were also great, the white bread pudding is decadent but the frozen bananas foster was the star. Don't skip this dessert cocktail, this was the highlight of the meal for me.

Overall, if you're looking for a nice dinner on vacation or a special occasion, I would highly recommend this place. We even had someone from the group come back later in her trip since she was fl
We had beignets, french toast, and waffle. French toast was very bland. Beignets were overrated. Coffee was not that strong. Great service though! Overall, not bad, but wouldn't visit again.

I've been to most of the sushi places in town and this is by far my favorite. The staff are wonderful and welcoming, the food is fresh and delicious and always comes very quickly. I used to go every couple weeks. I wish I still lived across the street from it.
Nice place with roomie booths.  Great pizza,  lots of toppings cooked perfectly.  What more could you want
Great food and really good service. Has a chill vibe and a fun place to hang out and just have drinks.

This is super close to my house so it's my go to place when I don't feel like cooking. It's a friendly atmosphere and the food is great. Never disappoints! My favorite dishes are the prime rib salad, Maggie's chicken, drunken chicken, the beef tips appetizer and the Reuben egg rolls! There's some kind of entertainment just about every night of the week. Servers are awesome! They seem to attract the real go getters! They never stop!! Our favorite is Leza!!

I grew up in Overland and have gone to Woofies many times.  Most certainly the best hot dog in the St Louis area.  This isn't a place you go to, to socialize, and spend an hour or better with your friends over a fine meal.  You go there to eat a hot dog like no other!
I ordered over the phone and my order was ready for take out in 10 minutes. Sushi was great! They have an option on their website to put in your info for COVID contract tracing if needed.

Great food and bar area. They are still limited capacity and social distancing is enforced. The servers are still wearing masks, as well. The servers hustle and the management team is on point with checking on tables and meeting your needs.

Expected a basic indian thali which would have been apt for a late lunch, i had been for.

Stale Chole (Channa Masala), Old Paneer Masalaa  - have never seen paneer fully in the red color which is also sour in taste ( usually its after 2 days).

I was on a call so just had the Roti (which was fresh) , Gulab Jamoon and trashed the food.

Highlight - When i told food is stale while paying the person at the billing counter without any prompt or questions  asks "Is it Chole", so they are aware of it and selling it.

Also before me there was an pregnant women having some food, didn't see whether it is the same dishes she had or something else.

This place was great. We had an excellent service experience with our server Carrie. She was ready to match wits and able to make great food and drink suggestions. Food was almost excellent, but 4 stars is really goo, nonetheless.  Nice job Prasino.

Awesome specials and great service! They have food specials for $9.99 till 6pm on certain nights and the happy hour was $2.99 for beers and $5 patron margaritas. Kay was our service and she provided excellent service!

To be honest,
  
I am not too sure why I don't hear people talk about this place more... but like a reviewer has said, this place is pretty much the closest to the rib cook off besides Famous Daves and Brother's BBQ.

I am also sitting down in the restaraunt itself writing this review because I honestly am that much enjoying my lunch at this very moment.
This is also my first time here and i've been working in Lemmon Valley for close to a year now.

I tried their Deal of The Day and it was a meat platter with pulled pork and a jalapeño cheese sausage with mac and cheese , waffle fries, and  a dinner roll, came with a drink and all was for about $10.  Which I personally think WORTH IT.

I personally like heat , so the jalapeño cheese sausage was good, and if you put their Spicy BBQ sauce on the pulled pork, seriously soooo good! The mac and cheese was the perfect temp, no cold spots and their dinner roll is  pretty good also.

Overall, i'll have to come back for lunches and try their other plates, but again , i'm surprised I don't hear much about this place. I'm very impressed.

I really wanted to like this place. I've been craving bbq for a while, so we decided to place a delivery order. The food came hot, smelled awesome, and we were stoked to see how much food was in the Rittenhouse meal. Sadly, we did not enjoy most of it. 

The good:
The chicken was ok - tender, super smokey. Almost too Smokey. 
Pulled pork was good. Very very salty, but good. 
Fries were nice and crispy and well seasoned. 

The bad:
The cornbread was gross. It has a weird seasoning, and was mushy and sticky at the same time. 
The ribs were tough and fatty. 
Coleslaw was just weird, as was the Mac and cheese. It was like all of these items has the same weird seasoning in them, and it just didn't work. 

Overall just not a good experience. I would not eat there again.
Great customer service and so many delicious treats to pick from! Grateful to have a place that understands what it means to be gluten free!
Staff is very friendly and very competent. Drinks and food arrive quickly. Food quality is quite good for a limited bar menu.  Great place to grab a bite to eat or watch a sporting event.

I'm originally from South Jersey and lived in philly for about 5 months now, the one thing I miss most is a quality plate of wings and this is the only place that even comes close. Great corner bar that serves as both a divey bar complete with a kiss pinball machine as well as a nice dimly lit restaurant in the back to take a date. The Wings are top notch, hummus plate is a must and the cocktails are professionally crafted. There's a lot of good places to eat in the city and this is one of the few worth going back to.

I love this pizza guys location. They have always been super nice, generous with their coupons, and generally nice to deal with. I order once a week or so for pickup. I called tonight at 8:07 asking to place an order for pickup. The guy on the phone says, " I can't take any orders right now". I said, "ok, should I call back in 10 minutes or 30 minutes or what"? This guy was in such a panic. He said that he could not make a pizza for me tonight because he was understaffed. WTF? It's 8 o'clock. I ordered from Blaze Pizza instead and what a great place. They have curbside and no panic stricken person. I got an equally good pizza , if not better, with a free soda and a killer dessert and I didn't even have to get out of my car. It's funny how when you get bad service and are forced to go elsewhere, you find out what else is out there that is equally as good or even better with better service than you have been settling for. I may go back to Pizza Guys but there are definitely alternatives without the freaking out employee!

Fo
First time in a while we ordered carry out from KSR. With that said we ordered Cajun dry and the wings were so over fried the wings were hard to swallow. It's sad when the highlight of the meal was the celery and carrots.

We celebrated my wife's birthday at Toma Restaurant. Outside dining was perfect. My wife enjoyed the lasagna dinner an I enjoyed the clams with black pasta in a tasty garlic sauce.  Our server was wonderful and his Italian wine suggestion was perfect.

Today was not a stellar day for Mulligan's.  My lunch buddy had his heart set on cheese curds and they were out of them.  I ordered the chicken tacos I have raved about before and what arrived looked unfamiliar.  No "cheese skirt" and in fact no cheese at all.  I am kind of ok with the no cheese but I found the tacos bland.  The waitress was apologetic and told me it is possible to request the cheese skirt.
I returned to Mere Bulles this year for valentines. The dinner was pitch-perfect. I intend to return much sooner this time!
We have eaten here multiple times. The food is normally excellent and I highly recommend if you are looking for a great burger

The 5-star trifecta: great food, great service and a beautiful venue. We were totally blown away by the Library and are sorry we waited so long to try it. It is, strangely, attached to the hospital but it occupies a beautiful corner location. We read that it can get crowded, but reservations on a Thursday night proved unnecessary as the crowd was light. I started with the Mannahatta, their craft variation on a Manhattan. Tasty and well balanced. But it was the first dish that blew us away. 

Our appetizer was the Benne Cauliflower. This was an amazing appetizer. The cauliflower was perfectly roasted and then tossed in a delicious sweet chili sauce that also featured fish sauce. Wow.

Next was the spaghetti bolognese. This was a huge portion of fresh pasta tossed with an abundance of meat (sausage and veal) in a thick tomato sauce. Delicious. The only thing I didn't  like was the fried basil: imho while it looked pretty, the dish would have been better served with a sprinkling of chopped fresh basil. Of course, when Mac and Cheese is on the menu as a side, it's a must have (pasta with pasta? You bet; don't judge). The hint of truffle was perfect for the creamy pasta. 

I'm glad we opted for dessert. The chocolate, pecan bread pudding was perfect. I especially loved the crispy bits along the edge of the ramekin. They were featuring a house made ice cream with bourbon that night and were happy to substitute it for the chocolate ice cream that normally comes with the dish. I'm gl

It pains me to write this review but I have to, Ive been ordering from here for a while however tonight my order was wrong. I politely called and the woman who claims she's the owner kept cutting me off saying I don't have time and telling me it was my mistake. She hung up the phone on me after saying we're too busy to deal with this. I've never ordered take out from a place who messed up an order then didn't atleast offer a solution to drop off the correct order in exchange for the wrong one. Horrible rude customer service all around.

These 5 stars are for all of the negative reviews from Mother's Day of unrealistic people having higher expectations of stupid 3rd party apps such as grub hub and door dash that take 30% of businesses sales and honestly don't care if an order gets canceled because they still get their money at the end of the day, I LOVE FELLINI CAFE OF MEDIA  Fellinis is the best and my opinion will never change.  For the people that use Door Dash and Grub Hub, call the restaurant yourself!!

Delicious sushi! Tiger eye roll was hands down the best. Although they have limited indoor seating because of Covid, they have a tent and chairs set up outside trying to help the situation. Every roll we ordered was delicious. The waitress' were friendly and trying their best to serve both indoor and outdoor seated guests. Amazing!

Ordered this on Uber eats for dinner. The bread it came with was super delicious. Crispy on the outside, chewy on the inside, and buttery. I didn't really care for the marinara sauce. It was kind of watery and I'm not really sure what the flavor was supposed to be. Veggie bowl was super fresh and filling. Veggies were grilled well

I've been wanting to go here for almost a year and finally went with a friend. The space is pretty large and there are a lot of tables. Ambiance is really nice too so I think this would be a nice place for a date if you don't mind the noise. It was kind of crowded when we went (Sunday morning around 10:30) but we still got seated without waiting. When we left (around 12) there were quite a few parties waiting to be seated so I would arrive early if you don't want to wait.

Even though it was pretty busy, our waitress was very attentive! She was also really nice which is worth noting since I find that service at most places is average. Food came out quickly too. We got the huevos rancheros, buttermilk pancakes, fruit salad, matcha latte, and London fog. Everything tasted pretty good but I think next time I will definitely try the cannoli French toast.

If you're looking for a brunch place, definitely check out Cafe Lift.

We had a recommendation from a local to try this spot out...we went for the Judy "JuJu" omelet with American cheese and hash-browns. We sat at the bar in front of the grill and it was fun to watch them cook all the food. Our order came out timely and looking delicious! We dug in to find a generous portion of shrimp, spinach, onion, and cheese. The flavors melt together to form a perfect bite! Really enjoyed it. The servers were funny and nice...we had a great time talking to them. They also were very attentive and kept our drinks full! Overall a great meal. Would gladly be back!!
The absolutely great quality.Everything is freshly baked daily.The best pastries I had in a long time.

The Mockingbird is an amazing restaurant.  We had the french savory waffle, the mini brie grilled cheese sandwiches, the chicken pot pie, and the gnocchi.  The appetizers were awesome, especially the brie grilled cheese.  The gnocchi was excellent.  The only dish that wasn't a 5/5 was the chicken pot pie, which had too strong of a taste of celery salt.
This place is AMAZING! Coolest speakeasy vibe and really great drinks. The waiters are so knowledge on the drinks, and will help you find your perfect drink.

This place was okay, location was great! And for how busy it was, it didn't take too long but the food was just okay. We ordered beer which was great but our glasses were soaking wet and smelled like fish which wasn't the best but we didn't make a fuss. Overall, I imagine there are better places to eat but location wise, it's right on the pier, so if you care more about location, I would choose this. I would come here again if someone said they wanted to go, but I wouldn't suggest it visiting.

Let me start this off by saying, I don't typically eat vegetarian or vegan so I wasn't sure what to expect. I had the carnitas and they were incredible. The corn tortilla was crunchy on the edges yet still soft where the filling was and the carnitas were flavorful and tender. I normally don't even like tomatoes or sour cream but I LOVED this pico and cashew crema. It was light, fresh, and probably the most flavorful Mexican food I've had without it feeling heavy at all. I'm excited to go back and try even more or maybe pick up some carnitas to cook at home from their refrigerated section.

Tonight we had dinner for a birthday celebration at this location. Our reservation    was for 4:00 and we could not be seated until 75% of our party arrived. This is what we we told when the reservation  was made. Some of out party would be running late so we decided to have a couple of drinks while we wait. Glad we did.

Danielle at the bar was awesome. As always we were greeted with a smile and suggestions for drinks. Guys went with the Happy Hour beer specials which were about 4.25. Others in the waiting party decided to go with martinis. Very good choice. The drinks were made perfect. You could tell the liquor was there, however they were not to strong for the ladies in our party to enjoy. Danielle  mad a special drink that had a mango taste. It was simply amazing. We called it the Danielle Special when we ordered more once we got to the table.

Now we are at the table!  This is were the 5 stars went from 5 to 3!

The two people assigned to our table was not give the same friendly vibes that we ALWAYS get when visiting  BlackRock.

The male - yes I said the male only because he never gave his name came over and said first thing is we need to decide how we are handling the checks. Wow! After explaining the check situation he advised two people in our party which one was the birthday girl "She will  take your order since she has the other table and you 4 are on the same check" .. this was over looked. 

Now time to order my food. Ordered the Tuna! It was amazing. Very fresh
Great spot in Sylvan Park! Food was great and came out so quickly, nice outdoor patio. Lots of vegetarian options as well. Really enjoyed it here !
Great place for breakfast or lunch.  The pancakes, waffles, french toast, corned beef hash, etc are delicious.

Outstanding service and great food for the price point. They are willing to change some items to accommodate customers. I've been going steadily for past 6 months, exploring their lunch & dinner menus.

My absolute fav dish is the rare New Zealand Green Lip Mussels, sauteed to taste, esp. with oil & garlic & spices or Fra Diavolo, as on the menu.

Huge salads & sandwiches for lunch but they serve their dinner menu all day.
Chicken  & veal dishes are outstanding, especially the marsalas & picattas. Many tasty Italian dishes, prepared as in my childhood.


https://www.tripadvisor.com/ShowUserReviews-g53038-d2403592-r780284485-Piazza_Presto-Limerick_Pennsylvania.html#

Very horrible experience. Stay away if you are a latino.  I never felt so much hate in my life.  They are racist. The woman at the drive thru full of tattoos look very upset  to us for nothing.  Slammed the window in my face because I asked for 1 extra jelly after I bought 8 biscuits. The Food was old, hard and disgusting extremely disrespectful. Been going to MickeyDs my whole life all over the world and never been treated like this ever. Lets put it this way their family tree looks more like a family stick.
One of our go to places. Consistently great food and drinks and the prices are reasonable for the experience.  I hope they bring back the eggplant Parmesan. It's my favorite! Highly recommend.

I had heard great things about this pizza restaurant and I finally had the opportunity to try it out. IT WAS AMAZING!!! Our party started with chicken wings and the spinach artichoke dip! Absolutely delicious! We weren't prepared for the unbelievable Chicago pizza (meat lovers and supreme)!!! The pizza is about 4 inches (or more) thick and stuffed with a variety of ingredients. The sauce had a perfect zesty flavor (totally Italian) and then cheese, cheese and more cheese!!! TRULY OUTSTANDING!!!! The service was spectacular and the prices were great! (Couldn't leave without trying the homemade ice cream)...WOW!!!

There is ample sitting both inside and out the store. It makes it a very nice spot to buy food from the deli and sit down to eat it rather than carrying the food elsewhere. Speaking of the deli, they have a great range of sandwiches to choose from and had more sides than I expected. They also serve La Colombe coffee which is a plus! Of the few times I have ordered from the deli, they have been very quick and didn't miss a step in the order. Ordering from the deli is reminiscent of a Wawa as they have touch screen panels to ring in your order. In the rest of the store, they have a very large snack selection and a relatively decent sized beer selection. Very convenient to grab a 6-pack on the go.

I was fairly disappointed with this ice cream. Despite being a local creamery, the scoop didn't taste particularly fresh. The mouthfeel was slightly chalky and dry. And the oxygen content on this scoop was higher than I'd like, leading to a rough feeling on the palate and a faster melting experience.

The food here is mediocre and the service is trash!!!! I've tried so hard to give this restaurant a chance but every time I come here there is something wrong.  I always order ahead so I don't have to wait and of course they completely lost my order so I had to wait.  No one offered me anything to rectify it she just offered to make it again like wtf that's not gonna help now I'm already late

Love the outdoor seating they have available right now! They always have a great drink selection and I haven't tried anything I didn't love. Highly recommend the pizza, the fall off the bone salad, and the brisket and egg sandwich. Thankful for this spot in our neighborhood!

Visiting from WA and wow! Apparently I didn't know what real sushi is because that was AMAZING!! Great people, great service, and impeccable food. Plus, I'm chopstick challenged and they took the time to make me cheater chopsticks. Would drive hours for this!

Not sure why it took me so long to find this spot but I am so glad I did. It's patio style seating and really mice on the inside. Loved their breakfast options. They have limited menu so definitely check it out before u go. Thank

My wife and I enjoyed another 5 course wine dinner hosted by Normandy farms.  The food was outstanding and the wine pairings with the food was phenomenal.  The pea and mushroom pasta was my favorite dish. We can't wait until the next one!
Great bbq and great service! And I mean who doesn't like deep fried Oreos and donuts?!

I'm glad that there's a local chain coffee place that has a drive thru in South Tampa. 

That being said, after finally trying Kahwa (I had been on a coffee hiatus for years, and then, well, COVID), it was underwhelming. It's just coffee, no better than Starbucks or Dunkin. I'd rather support other local coffee roasters that have bettter products, like Buddy Brew.

This location has a drive thru, and when I went through, it was fast and efficient. The staff handling the drive thru wore masks. Currently, they are not accepting cash, so bring your credit card.
I love Qdoba, but not this location - too many mumbling teenagers and not enough adult supervision.

ahh I love it here at Kaffeine!! Its probably one of the most hidden tucked away coffee shops in Indy! parking is limited so if you live close enough just walk or ride. 

The staff is always great, the inside is super rustic, big and airy. reminds me of a giant loft or warehouse. Old used furniture with private and shared seating areas. One small high top bar for those just looking to work alone. 

It can get quite busy in here and you might have to wait for a place to sit. but that is to be expected at a coffee shop downtown Indy. 
I haven't been since COVID so I'm not sure what they are doing during the pandemic as there is no outdoor seating.

So good! We stopped here on the way to a Blues game and were impressed by the food. I got the beef brisket and pulled pork. My buddy got the ribs. Both were excellent. The coal slaw and beans were really good too. Don't forget to get some corn bread as it was authentic and amazing!

I had the complete Montreal Style Short Rib dinner delivered to me in Brooklyn NY and it was AMAZING!!! The entire dinner was spot on! When I leave this god forsaken area I will make it a point to visit Abe Fisher and order another meal!! If they are open by then I will order my typical buffet.... at any cost this is worth a stop in!!!!

What a great restaurant! My husband and I ate there in August of 2020 amid Covid-19 so we sat outside on a beautiful evening. The food is incredible! We have both traveled all over the world and had a lot of great food. Spice Finch is up there with the best. Yup, I said it. Instead of main courses we split quite a few small plates. The Trio of Spreads was so tasty and varying in flavor. The Date Truffles were tangy and delicious. The Baked Cheese was our favorite- served piping hot in a cast iron pan and crispy on the bottom. The Chocolate Tahini Cake was out of this world. The flavor so intriguing. Please try Spice Finch so creative chefs are able to stay in business.
Food was excellent! Had a variety of appetizers and an entree. Will definitely be back to expand trying more menu options!
Just absolutely disgusting food. The chicken managed to be both soggy and too dry to chew at the same time. Just horrible, the worst takeout I've had in years.

Pizza was delicious. Was on a work trip and sat at the bar. Bartender was attentive and helpful. I ordered a small Cesar salad, which was pretty average, but wanted some greens. Made my own small pizza, which was the showstopper. Would definitely visit again when back in Indy.
This place just became my go to for Asian cuisine. Chinese, Japanese, and Thai all under one roof. Little pricey, but it's worth it.

Iam beyond upset. My favorite sushi restaurant for the last 7 years.  
Had dinner here for my birthday the last 5 years. In a year: monthly dinners with girlfriends, my parents' anniversary, my sister's bachelorette dinner. 
Today for my birthday, 14 adults & 6 kids. Made a reservation last week & confirmed Friday. I asked if I can bring pizza & fries for kids. Over the phone they said ok, even put me on hold to speak with the manager. 

When we arrived today, lady behind the desk (same person I spoke over the phone twice) was beyond rude. 
She said: too much food, we are taking a table for kids that other costumers could use. We were there 1pm, we were the only one in the restaurant. We left 2:15pm, there were 2 other couples in the restaurant. 

My guests felt not welcomed & not comfortable. 
I spent $270  in a little over an hour. 
Iam going to miss always great food & amazing waitresses!

You could tell me this place had the cure for COVID, and I still wouldn't eat here. Worse experience ever! Then after contacting them the following day the best they can do is issue out coupons ! Go to Hell with it ! Save your time and money because this ain't it! 

-Over cooked steak
-Roasted street corn dry and chewy 
-The ice cream for the skillet cookie never made it in the bag. After I originally requested for the cheesecake. 

Just a hot mess to make it all the way home $40 later with only a "to go" margarita and dry cookie  which also wasn't properly sealed for the safety of driving with an open container. 

I hate I had to leave this review but right now ain't the tome to be playing with folks food. GET IT TOGETHER

Visited Beyond bread for the first time and will be the last . The young man at the cash register was not very friendly and did not offer any assistance when asked if they had certain type of bread. He just stood there

Oh jeez, this place was horrible. I've never had worse food. Burnt thin patty couldn't even be called a burger. Sticky tables, smell of rotten fish and bad sceptic system only added to the unpleasant experience. It was also overpriced, to add insult to injury. Avoid!

This place is awesome. Every time I order it, it's worth it. Everything is always so fresh and hot. Food is great portions. Best Orange Chicken I've had. You can actually taste the citrus. Do yourself a favor and get it
New to the area and stopped by this cafe for coffee and to do some work. The Vietnamese coffee was a little too sweet for me, but that's just preference.  The staff was so welcoming and kind.

First, the good...
The prices aren't bad! And the bread is good. And the salmon and the Cesar salad were good.
And now for the not good...
The service for us was only okay, and I'm trying really hard to be gentle here. I didn't get the lemons I asked for, and he got a dessert spoon in his Coke for some reason. Our server chucked our plates at us (not even being drama queens, and we weren't at all rude to her). Her service isn't counted in my two stars, though. I can't hold the restaurant accountable in a review over one server (I think she was also new).
Two stars because the food was not good... came out cold and didn't taste good... and the place is so dirty. In the day and age of COVID, the tables aren't even cleaned between guests. We watched a huge party with wild kids running all over the place leave, their table was cleared but was never wiped down, and the poor couple who was sat right after, was brushing food off the table. And I said the prices were good, but that's except I made the mistake of getting that $18 salmon.... don't make my mistake. The salmon itself was good but the plate wasn't worth $18 and the other stuff they put on top of it is awful. The soup had no flavor.
We went in with low expectations and came out disappointed. I really wanted to like this place, everyone from here seems to really like it. We won't be back and I can't recommend this one.

My kids love the Cheesecake Factory!! I love the consistency of my favorite meals. The herb crusted salmon never disappoints. Irene was our server and was wonderful. She took the time to make my daughters birthday lunch a bit more special.  We appreciate the food and environment for families.
Blackened salmon was undercooked and the vegetables weren't seasoned. I don't recommend this restaurant.

Excellent service from the staff, very new place, ordered the awaze beef tips and honestly was astounded what a great flavor, the tortillas were like nothing i have ever seen, almost like fairy bread and pancakes combined.   Wow definitely be back yum

The best salsa and chips ever!
The food was very good.
The Guadalajara Mexican Grill is very nicely decorated in the style of Mexico.
Our waiter, Ernesto, was excellent.  Extremely attentive and pleasant.

Cool place to get a great cup of coffee! The young woman behind the counter was incredibly friendly and welcoming! Groovy relaxed atmosphere. The blueberry muffin was on point as well! We were in town from Massachusetts and it was the best spot in the area for coffee, IMO, we tried a few! Give it a shot! Or 2!

Awesome location and amazing food.  While there can sometimes be a bit of a wait depending on when you go, the experience is worth the wait.

Staff is very quick to respond.  Location has a conveyor belt to deliver items around the restaurant.  If you see something you like.  Grab it and enjoy.  If for some reason you can't get it (depending on where you're seated you may be end of the line which means tables before you have a better chance to get more desired items) just ask the wait staff and they can bring out a plate for your party.

Pricing is incredibly fair for other hot pot restaurants I've found. This location is also great for groups as well so if you gave a party of 8 or more you should be fine as the location has many large tables that can fit a large party.  

This place has become a regular visit as it hits all the marks we can ask.  They're also open until 1AM which makes the location a great spot for late dining.

Pub food done right!! T & T has delivered on its promise every time we have eaten there. The wings are meaty and sauce was tasty -have tried the root beer bbq and the spicy bbq. The Tomato soup and grilled cheese is a savory and comforting treat that is quite the surprise. The French fries are crispy and flavorful-(weird to comment on I know but sometimes sad,soggy fries can ruin a meal). My husband loved his blue cheese burger-almost to much to eat. And my kiddos really dug the queso and chips. 

Our server was kind and quick on the drink refills. They separate their dining areas for a family side and a bar side so there is a happy climate for everyone. I would definitely eat here again!

I went in to Java Station today to buy an iced coffee and use the restroom, I walked in smiled at the girl behind the counter and headed for the restroom, I informed them that my dog was a support dog and I had ESA papers. I continued into the bathroom and locked the door. The owner tried throwing me out of the bathroom because of the dog. He tried opening the locked bathroom door and pounded on it like he was going to knock it down screaming at me that he was calling the cops because I was breaking the law and then he started lying to them and telling them I was being aggressive. Meanwhile I'm still in the bathroom behind a locked door going pee. Not sure how im being aggressive ??? I come out and he forces his big belly on me and uses his body and one arm to force me out the back door. Then he starts screaming obscenities and calling me names all the while I'm only informing him that he's a support dog and I have ESA papers and in fact sir you're breaking the law and violating my rights by refusing me service and putting your hands on me. He calls me an aggressive angry bitter bitch and I pull out my video camera up in his face and tell him to say it again. He starts coming at me forcing himself on me and pushing me. Closing the door on me. I leave after I think get enough on video and call the cops. Unfortunately I I guess in my astonishment I didn't press record because it's not there, but there was witnesses. This man is unhinged and I can't believe he runs a business li

I had the pleasure of eating here when I visited Mew Orleans. The food was nothing short of amazing!  The highlight was getting to meet and talk with Ms. Leah (RIP).   If you ever get an opportunity to eat at this landmark, you are in for a treat!

Decent food, horrific customer service. Get ready to be ridiculed, belittled, and cursed out (BY THE OWNER). A secretary at our firm has the responsibility to place large orders for depositions and other events - I assist her. Although she was warned about the Owner (Mr. Stein himself) and his condescending attitude, she was compelled to place an order for the firm due to overwhelming demand. Big mistake, huge. He quickly informed her that larger orders (20+ sandwiches) could not be placed day-of but needed to be placed 2 days prior to pick up. I should note, this is not a posted policy. In fact, their catering menu page states simply "to call" regarding orders. 

She understood that the 1.5 hour notice was too little and agreed to find a restaurant that would take day-of orders. Mr. Stein insisted (after making extremely clear how inconvenient this is to him) that she go ahead and place the order. During the 15 minute phone call, he moaned and belittled her over the short notice and continued to refer to our locally owned firm and our order as a "shit show" throughout the entire conversation. 

I guess you cannot expect THAT much from someone who has a photo of themselves posing while throwing up the middle finger as one of their company photos. (I found this after looking for 2-day order policy on the website). Our experience at Stein's has left a nasty taste in our mouths, and it wasn't due to the food (lol sorry I couldn't help myself). 

I get Stein's shtick is to be rud
When I town I try to make it a plan to eat here, with my choice being the steak sandwich which is second to none each time I order it!!

Very unique and satisfying experience. Mexico City style cuisine. Different from the usual Mexican restaurant but in a very good way. Service very good though restaurant was nearly empty ( must add there was a steady stream of carry out customers).

We arrived a little later on in the day, about 1 hr before the market closed. By then, they had sold out of the crab. That was a bummer, but if knowing how busy it can get, I should've came earlier to see if I got some of that famous crab. We did try the Chargrilled Oysters and they were delicious. The oysters we got were of a pretty good size, in comparison to other local restaurants that we had gotten them in previous days. The staff was super friendly and curteous. They do call you baby, lol, which is fine by us. The shrimp tacos were very delicious. We also got a shrimp po'boy and I wasn't a big fan of that sandwich. All in all, the food and service was great!! If you're in the french market, they are definitely worth a try.

Took my mom here for the first time while she was in town! The tables were close together and it was pretty loud so it was hard to talk, but that is my only complaint. We started with a cheese board, which had a lot going on and all was delicious! Then for dinner I had the scallops and my mom had the snapper. We finished with the bread pudding. I'll def be back with some friends!
Terribly disappointing quality of food compared with all the hype. Overpriced and mediocre.

I have dined at Sperry's a number of times pre Covid as well as enjoyed take out during restaurant closure. We were excited to go back in person tonight for a special occasion. 
I was immediately concerned- many people in line for hostess stand without masks. Hostess asked guests to  put on masks while waiting which they did, but then promptly took off as they were seated across from us. 
We were seated within 5 minutes of reservation but I was shocked that tables were so close. In fact I could hardly get into my seat as the couple behind us was so close. Servers were wearing masks but guests walking throughout dining area without. Per the website we expected something much different. 
I enjoy Sperry's food very much but will not be back in the near future since I am considered a front line worker.

Guy that was supposed to be making my food paid no attention to me, as he was flirting with the girl in front of me. New guy came over to make my food, rude also. After thanking him I was rushed to the register, where homegirl was also.. rude. Didn't feel like they cared about anything besides getting rid of me. 

Missing queso. Went back up to ask for it, as I had told original guy I wanted it. Had to walk back to my table to get my wallet to pay for the queso, I was under the impression I had already paid for.

Being as it's Moes Monday and I should've gotten a burrito and drink for $5.99. And already paid $7.98. And wasn't offered a drink at my check out. 

There were only three tables in the establishment, and I've worked many restaurant jobs. I know between four people, there's no reason to be rude and rush people when there are only three tables. 

Food was fine. Only reason I'm giving two stars, because staff sucks.

Over the weekend, I visited Isaac Newton's. This was my second time visiting. The first time was a couple years ago and I don't remember much from that visit, but I'm glad I decided to pop in here again. 

The first thing I noticed when I walked in was the plexiglass at the hostess podium. They seem to be following necessary indoor dining safety measures, including staff wearing masks and keeping customers separated properly within the restaurant. I'm not sure if there was a maximum capacity for guests inside, but it wasn't crowded. We were asked if we would mind sitting at a tabletop by the bar. It was a comfortable space for all in my opinion. 

I ordered a White Claw and was not expecting it to be so big! It was like a pounder and took me forever to finish. To start, we ordered Buffalo cauliflower. I have to say, this was one of the most delicious buffalo cauliflower appetizers I've ever had. It's fried and crispy, but not greasy. Smothered in Buffalo sauce with blue cheese dressing underneath and pickled onions. 

I told myself I was going to be healthy this year and stay on track when dining out, so I ordered a Greek salad as my meal. The way this salad was crafted was absolutely insane. Tons of toppings including Kalamata olives, feta cheese, artichokes, and fried onions! Wow! The dressing was a plum vinaigrette and wasn't overpowering at all. My friend ordered a Caesar salad with grilled chicken and it looked very appetizing. The menu had a few protein options for thei
Oh Damn!!! Their pizza slices are huge and doesn't hurt the wallet. Will be back definitely for those wings bcuz they were out.

This place is a hole in the wall kinda place but has the most authentic Mexican food possible. Take out us recommended as there's only a few tables kinda meant for you to gobble up your food and leave. Best and most authentic seasoning in all their dishes.

So glad this place is still open, was afraid they weren't going to be with COVID-19 happening. Been coming here since they were originally called Jupiter Donuts, and I definitely will keep coming back. They got some pretty amazing donuts! And the staff is so sweet and helpful with recommendations.
Always a quiet little gem off Broad St. Wonderful service and friendly staff. Standard range of sushi, rolls, etc. But sometimes they have some off the menu items, which are delicious and fresh.

Excellent food! We stopped on our way home from Austin to Cali. Sandra was very personable. We had kids chic quesadilla. That was delish! And adults had enchiladas banderas!!! I would highly recommend
Great food and service. Priced appropriately and will be back! Pretty solid ambience and some nice outdoor seating when available.

Very nice bar/restaurant close to all the hotels in the vicinity. Food was good and plentiful drinks were balanced nicely with liquor and chaser. Would hog it recommend this place to those who stay in there area. Loads of Televisions to watch whatever current game is playing. They also do not mind if you have a request for a specific game or channel. I would most definitely return here if I come back to Tampa

I have seen Giordano's around and finally decided to give it a try. I stopped with the kids and we got sodas, cheese curds, and a medium pizza. Over $50 after tip. Kinda pricey but I assumed it would be around there. Our cheese curds were only okay. I've got to admit I'm a little overly picky with curds because I enjoy fresh squeaky curds, cheese curd lovers out there will know what I'm talking about and unfortunately they did not have that. It's pretty hard to find that at all in Indianapolis to be fair. Our pizza took quite awhile and I'm a little disappointed that my server didn't communicate that with me, possibly they could ask if people have been before or experienced Chicago style deep dish before...? It was most definitely a filling pizza but the sauce left a little something to be desired, just kind of bland, and my crust wasn't thick and sturdy to support all my sauce and toppings which I would've ate with a knife and fork even if it were because it's still a monstrous pizza. I just have an overall 'meh' feeling towards this place. But, either way I prefer Gino's in the actual Windy City and will only settle for Giordano's when driving the kids all the way to Chicago for my Chicago style pizza craving isn't an option.

I stopped here after the beach for a early lunch. I got the Don pressed sandwich and potato salad. Both items ordered were excellent. It tasted so good. Very fresh. The establishment is small and quaint. The employees were so friendly. Do yourselves a favor and make this Deli a priority stop! I will be back for more!

We arrived to the location and the exterior and patio were set up really cute. They have a cute photo opp before entering the restaurant. We sat down to an attentive waiter. The atmosphere was cute & we loved the DJ vibe. I ordered a French Cowboy whiskey drink and it was great!  They brought out sourdough bread that was warm and just "ok" the sauce they served with it tasted like what I would think onion juice tastes like. It was awful. We both ordered filets and they came pretty quick. They were cooked different, my husbands was undercooked while mine was cooked properly. We ordered mashed potatoes as the side. The sides come in the same size cast iron very small pan that the bread comes in, so keep that in mind.  The potatoes were very bland and not worth the $16. Our steaks were very charred (we ordered medium). I would not go back to the restaurant. Nothing was remarkable or impressive at all. Our bill was closer to $300 (with tip) for 6oz filet steaks, one side, and 4 drinks (2 each). We felt this place was VERY overpriced and underwhelming.

What can I say. The food is always excellent here. I always go with the all pastor tacos which are sooo tender and flavorful. Love the chicken taquitos as well. Great outdoor seating but be warned the line is long especially for breakfast.
